# `orders`
Columns: id, customer_id, amount, status, order_date
Measures: aov
Aggregations: _(none)_
Joins to: customers
Saved queries: monthly_rev

SQL:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), shifted_prev_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), sjoin_prev_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    base."orders.order_date",
    base."orders.revenue",
    shifted_prev_revenue."orders.revenue" AS "orders.prev_revenue"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_prev_revenue
    ON base."orders.order_date" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_prev_revenue."orders.order_date"
)
SELECT
  "orders.order_date",
  "orders.revenue",
  "orders.prev_revenue"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders.prev_revenue"
  FROM sjoin_prev_revenue
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.order_date" ASC
LIMIT 21
